note: The masks of Majora's Mask. Transformation masks change the body; the others change the story.

transformation.name: Deku Mask
transformation.power: spin, hop, fly on flowers — and the curse the Skull Kid laid on a boy who refused the mask

transformation.name: Goron Mask
transformation.power: roll like a boulder, punch like a landslide, sleep through danger

transformation.name: Zora Mask
transformation.power: swim the depths, throw fins like blades, sing under water

transformation.name: Fierce Deity's Mask
transformation.bearer: none — the mask of the moon's last gift
transformation.power: the double helix blade and the fury that ends Majora. Said to be the face of the hero when all other masks are one.

story.name: Skull Kid's Mask
story.note: the mask that started it — Majora, ancient and angry, riding the mischief of a lonely forest child

story.name: Couple's Mask
story.note: Kafei and Anju, married on the third day — the bond that outlasts the moon

story.name: Kafei's Mask
story.note: the stolen wedding mask of the Skull Kid; its theft broke four hearts

story.name: Mask of Truth
story.note: hear what the Gossip Stones dare not say

story.name: Romani's Mask
story.note: the mask of the farm girl who saw the moon fall and refused to look away

story.name: Mask of Scents
story.note: the Deku Butler's lost son; the mask that remembers smell

story.name: Garo's Mask
story.note: the mask of the undying swordsman of Ikana — kill a Garo and the mask keeps his pride

story.name: Postman's Hat
story.note: deliver on time; the postman has never missed a deadline, not even for the moon

story.name: Bunny Hood
story.note: the fastest feet in Termina — carnival con-artistry at its purest
